content:
The prestigious television Emmy Awards kicked off this weekend, with winners in the creative arts categories announced first. The primetime ceremony will be held on September 14, when top prizes such as Outstanding Drama Series and Outstanding Comedy Series will be handed out.

But so far Apple should be pretty pleased with the recognition it has received, with its Apple TV+ leading the weekend tally with a record-breaking 20 awards. Most of those come courtesy of breakout comedy Widows Bay, which took home 8 wins and now looks poised to sweep all the comedy categories.

At the 2026 Emmys so far, Apple is in first place with 20 awards, followed by HBO Max with 16 and Netflix in third with 13. Once all the primetime Emmys are handed out, the latter two streamers may overtake Apple in total, but Apple will still land a respectable third place.

Apple is expected to dominate the comedy categories, but will lose out in the drama races to shows like The Pitt. The answer will be revealed next Monday.

So far, Widows Bay has 8 wins, Pluribus has 4, Margo's Got Money Troubles has 3, Palm Royale has 3, and documentary Mr Scorsese has 1.

Those add up to 19 awards for Apple TV+ titles; the 20th award in Apple's announced haul is for its 'I'm Not Remarkable' ad:

Widow's Bay

  • Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series: Betty Gilpin
  • Outstanding Production Design for a Half-Hour Program
  • Outstanding Casting for a Comedy Series
  • Outstanding Cinematography for a Series (Half-Hour)
  • Outstanding Original Dramatic Score for a Series
  • Outstanding Music Supervision
  • Outstanding Sound Editing for a Half-Hour Comedy or Drama Series or Animation
  • Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Half-Hour Comedy or Drama Series or Animation

Pluribus

  • Outstanding Production Design for a Contemporary Program (One Hour or More)
  • Outstanding Editing for a Drama Series
  • Outstanding Original Main Title Theme Music
  • Outstanding Sound Mixing for a One-Hour Comedy or Drama Series

Margo's Got Money Troubles

  • Outstanding Contemporary Costumes for a Series
  • Outstanding Contemporary Hairstyling
  • Outstanding Contemporary Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

Palm Royale

  • Outstanding Choreography for Scripted Programming
  • Outstanding Period Costumes for a Series
  • Outstanding Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

Mr. Scorsese

  • Outstanding Documentary or Nonfiction Series

Apple TV+ started this season with a record-breaking 89 Emmy nominations, so we'll see how many of those it can convert into wins by the time the primetime Emmy Awards are handed out on September 14. All of this undoubtedly further reinforces the high praise industry commentators have given to the overall quality of Apple's programming.
